mentions.name: Atlas Lives Here
mentions.description: A personal photography website that uses AI services for automatic photo tagging, color extraction, and novel photo discovery methods, including color-based discovery to find prints with specific color harmonies.
mentions.problem: There was no existing way to find photography prints for a house with specific color harmonies.
mentions.source_excerpt: A personal photography website for myself using a bunch of AI services to enable automatic tagging, color extraction, and hopefully some novel discovery methods.

evidence.value: A personal photography website for myself using a bunch of AI services to enable automatic tagging, color extraction, and hopefully some novel discovery methods.
